decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game by using powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Show and Tell to gain advantage while also utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly bring out powerful creatures. The deck includes a variety of tutors and counterspells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategies. It also has access to ramp cards like Lotus Petal and Moxen to accelerate its game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to disrupt the opponent while setting up strong plays with Oath of Druids and other powerful spells.

This deck utilizes a combination of countermagic, disruption, and card advantage to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Spell Pierce, and Misty Rainforest, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also maintaining card advantage through cards like Demonic Tutor, Ancestral Recall, and Brainstorm. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value by recurring key cards from the graveyard. Overall, the deck aims to control the game, disrupt the opponent, and win through incremental advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of countermagic, card advantage, and powerful artifacts. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Force of Negation, and Mindbreak Trap, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage with cards like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise. Additionally, the deck can quickly accelerate its game plan with powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Bolas's Citadel. By efficiently controlling the game and utilizing powerful artifacts, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver its opponents in a Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying hatebear creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to disrupt opponents' strategies while also using aggressive creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Anointed Peacekeeper to apply pressure. It also includes cards like Trinisphere and Chancellor of the Annex to further slow down opponents and prevent them from casting spells efficiently. The deck aims to punish opponents for playing non-creature spells and control the game with disruptive creatures and efficient mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Moxen.

The deck focuses on using powerful card draw spells, efficient creatures, and disruptive spells to control the board and win through aggressive plays. By utilizing cards like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise, along with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Snapcaster Mage, the deck aims to maintain card advantage while applying pressure on the opponent. With a mix of proactive and reactive spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, the deck can adapt to various strategies while maintaining a fast pace. Additionally, the inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den allows for additional value and recursion throughout the game.

This deck is an aggressive strategy that focuses on disrupting the opponent while applying pressure. It relies on Hatebears, creatures that have disruptive effects, such as Collector Ouphe and Archon of Emeria, to slow down the opponent's game plan. It also utilizes efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to deal with threats. To further disrupt the opponent, the deck includes disruptive creatures like Grief and Outland Liberator. The deck also has powerful reanimation spells like Reanimate to bring back powerful creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying fast and aggressive pressure.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements to protect a powerful win condition, Oath of Druids. The deck includes various tutors and draw spells to find key cards such as Show and Tell or Flash to cheat in powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier. With a combination of counter spells, disruption, and mana acceleration, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful threats. Additionally, cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Bolas's Citadel provide additional versatility and win conditions to outmaneuver opponents.

The deck focuses on using multiple tutors, rituals, and draw spells to quickly assemble a winning combo using Doomsday, Thassa's Oracle, and various disruptive elements like Force of Will and Narset, Parter of Veils. By efficiently drawing through the deck and setting up a specific pile with Doomsday, the player can win the game in a single turn. The deck aims to control the game through counter magic and hand disruption while setting up its combo finish. It prioritizes speed and precision to execute its game plan effectively.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to utilize a combination of powerful control spells, disruptive creatures, and efficient card advantage engines to dominate the game. By leveraging counterspells like Force of Will and disruption cards like Wasteland, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and prevent the opponent from executing their game plan. Additionally, the inclusion of card draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Dig Through Time, along with tutors like Demonic Tutor, ensures that the deck has access to its key pieces consistently throughout the match.

The deck focuses on using powerful control spells and artifacts to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own win condition. It combines efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares with disruptive cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Lavinia, Azorius Renegade to control the game. The deck also utilizes powerful artifacts like Time Vault, Bolas's Citadel, and Manifold Key to generate advantage and close out the game quickly. With a mix of card draw, counterspells, and threats, Esper Control aims to outmaneuver opponents and control the game from start to finish.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells and disruptive creatures, while also utilizing powerful ramp and card advantage spells to gain an advantage. It aims to control the board with cards like Collector Ouphe and Leovold, Emissary of Trest, while also pressuring the opponent with efficient threats like Tarmogoyf and Oko, Thief of Crowns. The deck can quickly turn the tide of the game with cards like Force of Will and Time Walk, allowing for a versatile and adaptable playstyle that can catch opponents off guard.

This deck aims to rapidly deploy large threats such as Hogaak, Vengevine, and Hollow One by utilizing the graveyard and making use of powerful synergies like Bazaar of Baghdad and Gaea's Cradle. It leverages aggressive creatures like Hexdrinker and Blazing Rootwalla to pressure the opponent and disrupt their game plan with cards like Force of Vigor and Collector Ouphe. The deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, capitalizing on explosive starts and efficient disruption to secure victory in the early turns of the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Underworld Breach and Tinker to quickly assemble powerful combos and disrupt opponents with counter magic and removal spells. By efficiently generating mana with artifacts like Black Lotus and Moxen, the deck aims to cast game-winning spells like Brain Freeze or Bolas's Citadel. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Mystic Tutor and Demonic Tutor helps to find key pieces of the combo. The deck's ability to draw cards with Sensei's Divining Top and Gitaxian Probe provides consistency, while cards like Lightning Bolt serve as versatile removal options.

This Vintage deck focuses on aggressive creatures that also disrupt the opponent's game plan, known as Hatebears. By playing creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex, the deck slows down the opponent's spells and makes it harder for them to execute their game plan. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Solitude and Archon of Emeria to deal with threats. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to combine aggression with disruption to control the game and come out on top.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient card draw, disruption, and mana acceleration to apply early pressure on the opponent while controlling the board. By efficiently using cards like Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm, along with powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Lurrus of the Dream-Den, the deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent through tempo advantage. By combining elements of aggro and control, the deck seeks to maintain flexibility and adaptability in order to secure a decisive victory in the early game.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hate cards. By playing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex, the deck aims to slow down the opponent's spells, while also applying pressure with creatures like Archon of Emeria and White Plume Adventurer. The inclusion of cards like Trinisphere and Thalia, Heretic Cathar further disrupt the opponent's mana base and board development. With a mix of aggressive threats and disruptive elements, the deck aims to control the game and secure a victory through consistent pressure and disruption.
